newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed ahead of weekend.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to open mixed on Friday amid squaring of positions ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
"The sentiment is mixed so we can expect a range-bounded trading day," a dealer at a foreign brokerage house said.
On Thursday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 8.61 points, or 0.55 percent, to end at 1,552.80. Losers led gainers 163 to 89.
Turnover rose to 73 million shares from 72 million in the previous session.
